environment.description: Same EKS deployment in namespace 'data-pipeline-prod'. Cluster uses Cilium CNI with a CiliumNetworkPolicy (not standard K8s NetworkPolicy) that applies label-based L3/L4 filtering. The policy spec uses a CiliumClusterwideNetworkPolicy with endpointSelector matching pods labeled app=archive-processor, with egressDeny rules targeting CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 on TCP port 80. However, the policy only covers IPv4 link-local; the actual enforcement depends on Cilium's eBPF datapath being loaded on the node, which is confirmed via cilium status showing 'KV store: Ok, Controllers: 47/47 healthy'. Additionally, the node's iptables has a REJECT rule in the OUTPUT chain for destination 169.254.169.254 added by a DaemonSet running ip-lockdown (custom admission). IMDSv2 is NOT enforced (HttpTokens: optional remains).

config.iptables_daemonset: ip-lockdown adds OUTPUT -d 169.254.169.254 -j REJECT in host network namespace
config.cilium_status: KV store: Ok, Controllers: 47/47 healthy, Nodes: 12/12
